description:
Inner Peace Music | Sarangi Healing | 1.5 Hours

If your chest is tight and you can't quite name why — this is where to start. The Sarangi doesn't ask you to explain. It just holds the feeling until it softens.

90 minutes of slow Sarangi in Raga Bageshri, tuned to 432Hz with a gentle Theta layer. Made for moments when you need to come back to yourself.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sarangi — a bowed string instrument with one of the most human-like voices in Indian classical music
- Slow, aching phrases with space to breathe in between
- A soft low-frequency layer to help the nervous system settle
- Unbroken sound — no jarring transitions, no sudden shifts

⏱ Chapters
0:00   First breath
15:00  Letting go
35:00  Settling in
60:00  Deep calm
80:00  Coming back

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Sit or lie down. Don't try to feel anything specific — just let the Sarangi do what it does. Works with headphones or just in the room around you.

⏱ Best for:
• Quiet grief or unnamed sadness
• After a hard conversation
• Emotional exhaustion
• Evening wind-down
• Moments when you just need to feel okay again

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate gold-and-cream patterned border with subtle lotus and vine motifs, aged warm parchment background, soft late-afternoon palette (warm amber with fading golden light). Central figure: serene woman in a deep rose-and-cream sari with gold accents, seated cross-legged, holding a Sarangi (short bowed string instrument with a wide resonating body) in her lap, eyes half-closed in absorption. A soft indoor scene — a low window with warm light filtering through sheer cloth, a few marigold petals scattered on the floor. Gentle, tender mood — not sorrowful, not celebratory, just quietly present. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'INNER PEACE' centered, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Aged warm cream parchment palette, contemplative healing mood, single composed scene, no clutter.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Warm bowed Sarangi solo in raga Bageshri, deep emotional healing mood, slow expressive melodic phrasing with natural pauses and silences, no percussion, no tabla, 432Hz tuning, 65-75 BPM slow tempo, mid-to-low register (warm resonant bowed tone, not bright or thin), sparse phrases with emotional weight — each phrase feels considered, not continuous. Cinematic meditation production, hypnotic and tender, suitable for extended looping in post-production. Begins immediately with Sarangi already playing, full sonic presence from first note. Emotional tag: deeply tender, like grief that has finally found a safe place to rest.

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Bageshri — tonic D or C. Sarangi mid-register warm bowed tone — avoid thin/bright rendering. Sparse phrasing with emotional weight is critical: Sarangi's strength is in its sustained, aching notes — do not over-fill. Mix: Sarangi -2dB, Binaural -20dB (subtle Theta layer, should not overpower), Tanpura drone -22dB. LUFS -14dB (healing lane, not sleep — slightly louder than sleep content).
